item.title: North Korea Criticizes Japan's Largest-Ever Defense Budget Push: "Preparation for War of Aggression... Will Retaliate Thoroughly" (북한, 일 최대 방위비 편성 추진에 “침략전쟁 준비…철저히 반격”)
item.description:
North Korea criticized Japan's Ministry of Defense for pushing to compile a record-high defense budget of 10 trillion yen (approximately 88 trillion won), stating, "There is no doubt that this will lead to military buildup aimed at completing preparations for a war of aggression," and vowing, "We will retaliate thoroughly with united strength." <<> The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 22nd, citing a commentary published in the Rodong Sinmun, saying, "Thinking that the wicked militaristic nature of aggression and war can be disguised under the guise of defense and self-defense is a foolish delusion." <<> Earlier, Japan's Ministry of Defense set aside defense spending of approximately 8.9 trillion yen (about 79 trillion won) in its budget proposal for the next fiscal year. Additionally, there are about 150 'unspecified request' projects without fixed amounts, making it possible for the final budget to reach around 10 trillion yen in total, the largest ever. <<> The commentary criticized the "dangerous expansion of a war budget that brings new turmoil to the region and the world," adding, "Reckless arms buildup cannot guarantee the future of the Japanese archipelago, and breaking records on war spending will only increase Japan's 'security deficit.'" <<> It further stated, "It is all too clear that the purpose of squandering vast amounts of taxpayers' money on mass-procuring various long-range strike capabilities, such as U.S.-made Tomahawk cruise missiles, and developing offensive weapons, despite fiscal deterioration, is by no means aimed at building a peaceful nation." <<> It then emphasized, "Successive Japanese governments have talked about threats from around them, increasing defense spending to record levels year after year, and using the cunning method of adding supplementary budgets to transform the Self-Defense Forces into modernized, preemptive-strike-capable armed forces," adding, "We will absolutely not tolerate the military evolution of the descendants of war criminal states that threaten global peace and security, and we will retaliate thoroughly with united strength." <<> Reporter Park Jeong-yeon yeon@hani.co.kr (북한은 일본 방위성이 10조 엔(약 88조 원)에 달하는 역대 최대 규모 방위비 예산 편성을 추진하는 데 대해 “침략전쟁 준비완성을 위한 무력증강으로 이어지리라는 것은 두말할 여지도 없다”며 “단합된 힘으로 철저히 반격할 것”이라고 비판했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "Can't Yield Even 1cm of Yongsan Park"... Kim Young-bae: "Only His Own Politics" (오세훈 “용산공원 1㎝도 양보 못 해”…김영배 “자기 정치만”)
item.description:
Kim Young-bae, a lawmaker who serves as the chair of the Democratic Party of Korea's Seoul City chapter, met with Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon on the 22nd to discuss plans for housing supply utilizing the Yongsan Park site, but the two failed to narrow their differences. (더불어민주당 서울시당 위원장인 김영배 의원이 22일 오세훈 서울시장을 만나 용산공원 부지를 활용한 주택공급 방안 등을 논의했지만 이견을 좁히지 못했다.)

After a lunch meeting with Mayor Oh at the mayoral residence, Kim told reporters at the National Assembly, "We had various discussions regarding housing supply, but it was difficult to reach an agreement on the overall framework, and opinions sharply conflicted over issues such as Yongsan Park, the Yongsan maintenance depot, and the greenbelt." (김 의원은 서울시장 공관에서 오 시장과 오찬 회동을 한 뒤 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “주택 공급과 관련해 여러 논의가 있었지만 큰 틀에서 합의하기 어려웠고, 용산공원과 용산 정비창, 그린벨트 문제 등에 팽팽하게 의견이 맞섰다”고 전했다.)

The government is reviewing measures to expand housing supply, including building youth housing on part of the Yongsan Park site and easing greenbelt regulations in Seoul. Earlier, on the 20th, Land, Infrastructure and Transport Minister Kim Yun-deok also met with Mayor Oh to discuss utilizing Yongsan Park for housing supply, but Mayor Oh made clear his opposition to developing Yongsan Park. (정부는 주택 공급 확대 방안으로 용산공원 일부 부지에 청년주택을 조성하고 서울 그린벨트 규제를 완화하는 방안 등을 검토 중이다. 앞서 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관도 지난 20일 오 시장을 만나 용산공원 주택 공급 활용에 논의했으나, 오 시장은 용산공원 개발에 반대 입장을 분명히했다.)

Kim said, "Regarding supplying youth housing at Yongsan Park and the Yongsan maintenance depot, the Seoul Metropolitan Government strongly expressed its opposition, citing various legal issues and transportation problems." (김 의원은 “용산공원, 용산 정비창에 청년주택을 공급하는 것과 관련해 서울시는 여러 법상의 문제와 교통 문제를 이유로 강하게 반대 의사를 밝혔다”고 말했다.)

He added, "Mayor Oh said things like 'The greenbelt is off-limits' and 'I can't yield even 1cm of Yongsan Park,' which seems to reflect his desire to highlight himself as a politician with a valuable vision. I raised the criticism that while young people and citizens are struggling with housing difficulties, he is overly self-centered and focused only on his own politics." (이어 “오 시장이 ‘그린벨트는 안 된다’, ‘용산공원은 1㎝도 양보 못 하겠다’고 하면서 가치 있는 비전을 가진 정치인임을 부각하고 싶은 것 같다”며 “청년 등 시민들이 주거 어려움을 겪는데 너무 자기중심의 자기 정치만 하는 것 아니냐는 비판을 제기했다”고 말했다.)

However, he left room for cooperation, saying, "We confirmed that there is room for discussion on regulatory improvements, such as floor area ratio incentives for redevelopment and reconstruction projects. Mayor Oh also sympathized with the plan to use part of the Future Response Fund as a financial source for youth housing supply, and we agreed to actively discuss it." (다만 “재개발·재건축 용적률 인센티브 등 규제 정비 문제는 협의 여지가 있는 것을 확인했다”며 “미래대응기금 일부를 청년 주택 공급 재원으로 활용하는 방안에 대해선 오 시장도 공감해 적극 의논하기로 했다”고 협의 가능성을 열어뒀다.)

The Seoul Metropolitan Government also issued a press release after the meeting, stating, "Mayor Oh made clear his existing position that he opposes using the main site of Yongsan Park, which affects the quality of life of citizens, for housing supply." It added, "He proposed to (lawmaker Kim) that they jointly seek alternative sites to achieve substantive supply effects. The city also maintains its stance to actively search for alternative sites, such as the Tancheon Water Reclamation Center, where housing supply is possible even if it takes some time." (서울시도 이날 회동 이후 보도자료를 내고 “오 시장은 시민 삶의 질이 달린 용산공원 본체부지를 주택공급에 활용하는 것에는 반대한다는 기존 입장을 분명히 했다”고 밝혔다. 그러면서 “실질적인 공급 효과를 내도록 (김 의원에게) 대체 부지를 함께 찾아보자고 제안했다”며 “서울시는 탄천물재생센터 등 다소 시간이 소요되더라도 주택 공급이 가능한 대체 부지도 적극 물색한다는 입장”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, on the 20th, the Democratic Party and the People Power Party agreed to reflect the results of discussions between the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Seoul Metropolitan Government and pass amendments related to housing supply, including the Special Act on Yongsan Park and the Urban Redevelopment Act, at next week's plenary session of the National Assembly. However, with the Seoul Metropolitan Government and the ruling party failing to narrow differences over the use of the Yongsan Park site, difficulties are anticipated in the housing supply plans promoted by the government and the ruling party in central Seoul. (앞서 더불어민주당과 국민의힘은 지난 20일 국토교통부와 서울시가 진행 중인 논의 결과를 반영해 용산공원 특별법과 도시재정비법 등 주택 공급과 관련된 개정안을 내주 국회 본회의에서 처리하기로 합의했다. 하지만 서울시와 정부 여당이 용산공원 부지 활용 등에 이견을 좁히지 못하면서 정부와 여당이 추진하는 서울 도심 내 주택 공급에도 난항이 예상될 것으로 전망된다.)

item.title: President Lee to Host Luncheon for All Democratic Party Lawmakers at Presidential Residence on the 28th (이 대통령, 28일 민주당 의원 전원 청와대 초청 오찬)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung will invite all lawmakers of the Democratic Party of Korea to the presidential residence for a luncheon on the 28th, ahead of the regular parliamentary session. (이재명 대통령이 정기국회를 앞두고 오는 28일 더불어민주당 국회의원 전원을 청와대에 초청해 오찬을 함께한다.)

Kang Yu-jeong, the senior press secretary at the presidential office, told reporters on the 22nd, "President Lee will invite Democratic Party lawmakers to the Yeongbingwan guesthouse at the presidential residence for a luncheon on the 28th." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 22일 언론에 “이 대통령이 오는 28일 민주당 국회의원들을 청와대 영빈관으로 초청해 오찬을 함께할 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

The Democratic Party lawmakers are expected to attend the luncheon after completing a two-day, one-night workshop in Incheon starting on the 27th to prepare for the regular parliamentary session, then moving to the presidential residence. (민주당 의원들은 오는 27일부터 1박2일 일정으로 인천에서 열리는 정기국회 대비 의원 워크숍을 마친 뒤 청와대로 이동해 오찬에 참석할 예정이다.)

This is the second time President Lee has invited all Democratic Party lawmakers to the presidential residence, following a similar event in August of last year. In August last year, President Lee invited all lawmakers to the presidential residence for a luncheon on the occasion of the party workshop, strengthening party-government unity. (이 대통령이 민주당 의원 전원을 청와대로 초청해 만나는 것은 지난해 8월에 이어 두 번째다. 이 대통령은 지난해 8월 당 워크숍을 계기로 의원 전원을 청와대로 초청해 오찬을 함께하며 당정 결속을 다졌다.)

Prior to this, President Lee will also invite the new Democratic Party leadership to the presidential residence for a dinner on the 25th. New party leader Kim Min-seok, floor leader Han Byeong-do, along with members of the supreme council and key party officials, are expected to attend. (이 대통령은 이에 앞서 오는 25일에는 민주당 신임 지도부를 청와대로 초청해 만찬을 함께한다. 김민석 민주당 신임 대표와 한병도 원내대표를 비롯해 최고위원들과 주요 당직자들이 참석할 예정이다.)

This luncheon is seen as an effort to mend internal party rifts following the August 17 national convention and to reinforce the "one team" stance of the party, government, and presidential office ahead of the regular parliamentary session. On the 19th, two days after the convention, President Lee invited lawmakers Jeong Cheong-rae and Song Yeong-gil, who had competed with Kim for party leadership, to the presidential residence for a dinner. At that gathering, President Lee referred to the three as "comrades who have shared life and death, joys and sorrows" and urged unity, stating, "The party, government, and presidential office are a community of destiny bearing a shared historical mission and partners in state affairs." (이번 오찬은 8·17 전당대회 이후 당내 갈등을 봉합하고 정기국회를 앞두고 당정청의 ‘원팀’ 기조를 다지려는 것으로 풀이된다. 이 대통령은 전당대회 이틀 뒤인 지난 19일 김 대표와 당권을 놓고 경쟁했던 정청래·송영길 의원을 청와대로 초청해 만찬을 했다. 이 대통령은 이 자리에서 세 사람을 “생사고락을 함께한 동지”라며 “당정청은 시대적 소명을 함께 짊어진 운명 공동체이자 국정 동반자”라고 화합을 당부한 바 있다.)

item.title: How to Resolve Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae’s Unilateral Exercise of the Nomination Right (조희대 대법원장 제청권 일방 행사 어떻게 풀 것인가)
item.description:
Article 104, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution states: “Justices of the Supreme Court are appointed by the President with the consent of the National Assembly, upon the nomination of the Chief Justice.” The Chief Justice holds the nomination right, the National Assembly holds the consent right, and the President holds the appointment right. If the Chief Justice does not nominate, if the National Assembly does not consent, or if the President does not appoint, a Supreme Court Justice cannot be appointed. (헌법 104조 2항은 “대법관은 대법원장의 제청으로 국회의 동의를 얻어 대통령이 임명한다”입니다. 대법원장은 제청권이 있고, 국회는 동의권이 있고, 대통령은 임명권이 있습니다. 대법원장이 제청하지 않으면, 국회가 동의하지 않으면, 대통령이 임명하지 않으면 대법관은 임명될 수 없습니다.)

In particular, if the Chief Justice and the President each insist on different candidates, the appointment process for a Supreme Court Justice may not proceed at all. This is why the practice has been established over time for the President and the Chief Justice to effectively finalize the selection through prior consultation before entering the nomination-consent-appointment process. (특히 대법원장과 대통령이 각각 다른 인물을 고집하면 대법관 임명 절차가 아예 진행되지 않을 수 있습니다. 그동안 대통령과 대법원장이 사전 조율로 사실상 인선을 마친 뒤 제청-동의-임명 절차에 들어가는 관행을 만든 이유입니다.)

The Chief Justice cannot nominate Supreme Court Justice candidates at his own discretion. The Court Organization Act requires the Chief Justice to operate a Supreme Court Justice Nomination Recommendation Committee for recommending candidates to be nominated. The Chief Justice must respect the committee’s recommendations. (대법원장은 자기 마음대로 대법관 후보를 제청할 수 없습니다. 법원조직법은 대법원장이 제청할 대법관 후보 추천을 위해 대법관후보추천위원회를 두도록 했습니다. 대법원장은 추천위원회의 추천을 존중해야 합니다.)

The recommendation committee is composed of 10 members, including one chairperson, whenever the Chief Justice is to nominate Supreme Court Justice candidates. These include the senior Supreme Court Justice, the head of the Court Administration Office, the Minister of Justice, the president of the Korean Bar Association, the president of the Korean Law Professors Association, the chairperson of the Law School Council, one judge who is not a Supreme Court Justice, and “three persons of learning and virtue with extensive experience in various professional fields who do not hold attorney qualifications (at least one of whom must be a woman).” Once the recommendation committee recommends candidates, it is dissolved. <<> To nominate a successor for Justice Noh Tae-ak, who retired in March this year, a Supreme Court Justice Nomination Recommendation Committee (chaired by Choi Jae-cheon) was formed. On January 21, the committee recommended Judge Kim Min-ki of the Suwon High Court, Judge Park Soon-young of the Seoul High Court, Presiding Judge Son Bong-gi of the Daegu District Court, and Presiding Judge Yoon Sung-sik of the Seoul District Court. <<> Following practice, the presidential office and the Supreme Court began coordination. The presidential office favored Judge Kim Min-ki, a woman with progressive leanings, but Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae firmly opposed. The ostensible reason was that Judge Kim Min-ki is the spouse of Constitutional Court Justice Oh Young-jun. Seven months passed this way. <<> Eventually, Justice Noh Tae-ak retired and no successor was appointed. Meanwhile, Presiding Judge Yoon Sung-sik was designated as the presiding judge of the insurrection trial panel, and Judge Park Soon-young, a member of the National Election Commission, became embroiled in the controversy over the shortage of ballot papers in the June 3 election. <<> Separately, a new Supreme Court Justice Nomination Recommendation Committee (chaired by Park Eun-jeong) was formed to select a successor for Justice Lee Heung-gu, who retires in September. On August 4, the committee recommended Chief Judge Kim Mun-gwan of the Busan District Court, Presiding Judge Kim Sung-soo of the Seoul High Court, Presiding Judge Kim Ye-young of the Seoul Southern District Court, and Presiding Judge Kim Jung-jung of the Gwangju District Court. It is said that the presidential office and the Supreme Court agreed to nominate Presiding Judge Kim Sung-soo from among them. <<> The problem was the successor to Justice Noh Tae-ak. Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae suddenly broke with practice and submitted a written nomination for both Presiding Judge Son Bong-gi and Presiding Judge Kim Sung-soo at once. This appears to be a direct challenge to President Lee Jae-myung. <<> I believe Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae acted wrongly. Whether by persuading the President to the end or by yielding himself, he should have upheld the practice. In state affairs, practice often takes precedence over law. <<> Moreover, there is history between President Lee Jae-myung and Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae. Just before the presidential election, Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae referred the appellate review of candidate Lee Jae-myung’s election law violation case to the en banc panel, hastily deliberated it, and remanded it with a guilty finding. I suspect he would have liked to make a final judgment of guilt himself. <<> What would have happened if the Supreme Court had deprived candidate Lee Jae-myung of his eligibility to run through a final judgment? The people, as sovereigns, would not have remained silent. A civil revolution would have erupted. The Supreme Court under Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae would have been swept away. <<> This is exactly why the majority of the public supported the judicial reform that President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party pushed through after the election, despite opposition from the Supreme Court and the People Power Party. Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae may be an outstanding legal scholar, but he is unqualified, lacking an understanding of the most fundamental principle of the Constitution: popular sovereignty. <<> In the past, Presidents and Chief Justices have clashed over Supreme Court Justice selections on several occasions. Both the President and the Chief Justice made concessions to preserve the practice. <<> Let us first look at the case of President Roh Moo-hyun and Chief Justice Choi Jong-young. Former President Moon Jae-in, who served as Roh’s senior secretary for civil affairs, left a detailed record in his 2011 book, “Moon Jae-in’s Destiny.” <<> “In August 2003, there was a Supreme Court Justice crisis. The presidential office and the Supreme Court found themselves in a fairly difficult situation over the recommendation of a Supreme Court Justice. At the time, there was strong public opinion both inside and outside the legal community demanding that the composition of the Supreme Court and the Constitutional Court ensure social diversity, including the protection of human rights, women, and minorities.” <<> “When the Chief Justice began the selection process to nominate new Supreme Court Justice candidates, I conveyed the President’s wishes to the Supreme Court. I said the President hoped the nomination would aim for diversity in the Court’s composition, whether in terms of human rights, women, or minority protection. But the Supreme Court, perhaps having misunderstood the President’s intentions after hearing another interpretation, went ahead and nominated candidates in the traditional seniority-based manner.” <<> “Justice Minister Kang Geum-sil and Korean Bar Association President Park Jae-seung, who had attended the recommendation meeting as committee members, objected and walked out. Not to mention the progressive legal community, even younger judges raised objections. Presiding Judge Park Si-hwan of the Seoul Central District Court, respected for his reformist credentials, submitted his resignation. Some younger judges launched collective expressions of dissent, including circulating an online joint statement against the nomination process.” <<> “Realistically, it was not easy for the Chief Justice to withdraw the nomination. Nor was it easy for the President to simply accept a nomination that did not reflect the spirit of diversity.” <<> “In this dilemma, former Chief Justice Yoon Kwan stepped in as mediator and presented me with a resolution worked out with the courts: ‘If the President accepts this nomination, even if reluctantly, first, the Chief Justice will apply the diversity standard to the next Constitutional Court Justice recommendation, for which he has the recommendation right, and to the subsequent Supreme Court Justice nomination. And he will publicly promise to convene a national judges’ meeting to gather opinions and to apply the diversity standard to the next Constitutional Court and Supreme Court appointments.’ After confirming the courts’ commitment, I accepted the plan. Korea’s first female Constitutional Court Justice and first female Supreme Court Justice were born that way.” <<> Building on this trust between the President and the Chief Justice, the participatory government achieved considerable success in judicial reform. <<> President Lee Myung-bak and Chief Justice Lee Yong-hoon also clashed in August 2009. When Lee Myung-bak’s presidential office was displeased with the candidate Chief Justice Lee Yong-hoon intended to nominate, they expressed displeasure, saying, “There is no reason to meet the Chief Justice over the Supreme Court Justice nomination. The Supreme Court should henceforth submit its nominations in writing.” Chief Justice Lee Yong-hoon conceded, saying, “I will present three candidates and accept whichever one the presidential office chooses.” President Lee Myung-bak and Chief Justice Lee Yong-hoon met, and the nomination proceeded smoothly. <<> President Yoon Suk-yeol and Chief Justice Kim Myeong-soo also clashed. In May 2023, the Supreme Court Justice Nomination Recommendation Committee recommended eight candidates as successors for two retiring justices. Chief Justice Kim Myeong-soo sought to nominate progressive female candidates from among them. President Yoon Suk-yeol and the presidential office threatened to exercise a veto. In the end, Chief Justice Kim Myeong-soo bent his convictions and nominated two other candidates on June 9. <<> How should this matter be resolved now? The essence of this crisis is that Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae broke with practice, defied the President’s wishes, and submitted a written nomination for candidate Son Bong-gi. He exercised the Chief Justice’s constitutional nomination right “according to the law.” If so, President Lee Jae-myung can also exercise his authority “according to the law.” He can reject the nomination. <<> In that case, the Supreme Court would have to form a new recommendation committee. Once the committee recommends new candidates, Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae would have to nominate one of them again. If President Lee Jae-myung is dissatisfied with that person too, he would reject the nomination again. In the worst case, the Chief Justice’s nomination and the President’s rejection could repeat endlessly. But there is no help for it. This is the “new normal” that Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae brought upon himself. <<> There is precedent for the Chief Justice re-forming the recommendation committee and re-nominating. In July 2012, when candidate Kim Byung-hwa withdrew just before the National Assembly vote on his appointment consent, Chief Justice Yang Sung-tae formed a new Supreme Court Justice Nomination Recommendation Committee and nominated candidate Kim So-young again in October 2012. <<> In the wake of this crisis, the Democratic Party is demanding Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae’s resignation. Under the direction of Representative Kim Min-seok, banners calling for Cho Hee-dae’s resignation have been hung across the country. This is a political offensive. It is not right. It is cowardly. If Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae violated the Constitution or laws, the proper course would be for the National Assembly to impeach him. The reason they do not seek impeachment is likely because they believe the Constitutional Court would probably dismiss it. <<> A mid-term resignation by Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae would also place an enormous political burden on President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party. That is because it would appear to the public that the ruling camp is trying to seize control of the legislature, the executive, and the judiciary alike. Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae is set to retire next June anyway upon reaching the mandatory retirement age. The natural course would be for President Lee Jae-myung to appoint a new person as Chief Justice then, following proper procedures. Politics is common sense. What do you think? <<> Senior Political Correspondent shy99@hani.co.kr (추천위원회는 대법원장이 대법관 후보를 제청할 때마다 위원장 1명을 포함한 10명의 위원으로 구성합니다. 선임대법관, 법원행정처장, 법무부 장관, 대한변호사협회장, 한국법학교수회 회장, 법학전문대학원협의회 이사장, 대법관이 아닌 법관 1명, 그리고 “학식과 덕망이 있고 각계 전문 분야에서 경험이 풍부한 사람으로서 변호사 자격을 가지지 아니한 사람 3명(이 중 1명 이상 여성)”입니다. 추천위원회는 대법관 후보를 추천하면 해산합니다.)

item.title: Na Kyung-won: "Pursuing disciplinary action against Lee Jin-suk is tyranny... Will you also silence and punish calls to disclose the 5·18 meritorious list?" (나경원 “이진숙 징계 추진은 폭정…5·18 유공자 명단 공개도 입틀막할거냐”)
item.description:
As the Democratic Party of Korea pushed for disciplinary action against People Power Party lawmaker Lee Jin-suk for hosting a forum that denigrated the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement, People Power Party lawmaker Na Kyung-won pushed back, calling it "tyranny of the majority." Na also asked, "Will you silence and punish all public demands to disclose the list of May 18 meritorious persons and their contributions to the public and obtain national consent?" (더불어민주당이 5·18 광주민주화운동 폄훼 포럼을 개최한 이진숙 국민의힘 의원에 대해 징계를 추진하자 나경원 국민의힘 의원이 “다수결의 폭정”이라며 반발했다. 나 의원은 “5·18 유공자 명단과 공적 내용을 국민에게 공개하고 국민적 동의를 얻어야 한다는 국민적 요구도 모두 ‘입틀막’하고 처벌할 것이냐”고도 했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 22nd, Na wrote, "Democratic Party lawmakers submitted a motion for disciplinary action against Lee. Representative Kim Min-seok (DP) even said, 'If expulsion is difficult, let's at least suspend qualifications,' and the Democratic Party has gone further to propose a 'one-year suspension of lawmakers' duties law.' This is 'parliamentary totalitarianism' and a 'tyranny of the majority' that mocks the Constitution." ( 나 의원은 22일 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “민주당 의원들이 이 의원에 대한 징계요구안을 제출했다. 김민석 (민주당) 대표는 ‘(이 의원) 제명이 어려우면 자격 정지라도 하자’고까지 하더니 민주당은 ‘의원 1년 직무정지법’까지 발의하고 나섰다”며 “‘의회 전체주의’이자 헌법을 조롱하는 ‘다수결의 폭정’”이라고 말했다.)

Na said, "Under the National Assembly Act, the grounds for suspending a lawmaker's duties in the bill they proposed target 'lawmakers who have committed serious historical distortions regarding nationally confirmed democratization movements or state violence, or who hosted or organized related discussion forums.' This is targeted legislation aimed squarely at Lee, who held an academic forum. If this isn't dictatorship, what is?" ( 나 의원은 “그들이 발의한 법안의 국회법상 국회의원 직무정지 요건도 ‘국가적으로 확인된 민주화운동·국가폭력 등에 관한 중대한 역사 왜곡 행위를 한, 관련 토론회를 주최 주관한 국회의원’이 대상이다. 학술 토론회를 개최한 이 의원을 정면 겨냥한 표적 입법”이라며 “이것이 독재가 아니면 무엇인가”라고 했다.)

Na argued, "If the May 18 spirit is to be enshrined in the preamble of the Constitution, will you also silence and punish all public demands to disclose the list of May 18 meritorious persons and their contributions to the public and obtain national consent in line with that spirit?" She added, "The Democratic Party's behavior of treating May 18 as their exclusive property and abusing it as a weapon to eliminate political opponents is the most painful denigration of the May 18 spirit." ( 나 의원은 “5·18 정신을 헌법 전문에 담는다면, 그 정신에 부합하게 5·18 유공자 명단과 공적 내용을 국민에게 공개하고 국민적 동의를 얻어야 한다는 국민적 요구도 모두 ‘입틀막’하고 처벌할 것인가?”라며 “5·18을 전유물로 삼고 정적 제거의 무기로 악용하는 민주당의 작태야말로 5·18 정신을 가장 뼈아프게 폄훼하는 것”이라고 주장했다.)

Earlier, on the 21st, the Democratic Party submitted a disciplinary motion against Lee to the National Assembly. That day, Representative Kim said on X (formerly Twitter), "The Democratic Party will surely achieve Lee's expulsion, or at minimum, suspension of activities." ( 앞서 민주당은 지난 21일 이 의원에 대한 징계안을 국회에 제출했다. 이날 김 대표는 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에서 “민주당은 이 의원의 제명, 최소한 활동정지를 반드시 이뤄내겠다”고 말했다.)

Separately, Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Yong-woo proposed an amendment to the National Assembly Act on the 14th that would allow up to one year of suspension of duties for lawmakers who distort or denigrate the May 18 Democratization Movement. ( 별도로 이용우 민주당 의원은 5·18 민주화운동 등을 왜곡하거나 폄훼하는 의원에 대해 최대 1년 동안 직무 수행을 정지할 수 있도록 하는 국회법 개정안을 지난 14일 발의한 상태다.)

item.title: Hong Jun-pyo, to Han Dong-hoon over 'Noh Woong-rae's acquittal': "Want to examine illegally obtained evidence? Ignorant and uninformed." (홍준표, ‘노웅래 무죄’ 반발 한동훈에 “위법증거 까보자? 무식하고 무지”)
item.description:
After independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon objected to the acquittal of former Democratic Party lawmaker Noh Woong-rae in his second trial and said, "Let's listen to the (relevant) recording files," former Daegu Mayor Hong Jun-pyo criticized it as "an ignorant and uninformed argument." (한동훈 무소속 의원이 노웅래 전 더불어민주당 의원의 2심 무죄 선고에 반발하며 “(혐의 관련) 녹음파일을 들어보자”고 하자, 홍준표 전 대구시장이 “무식하고 무지한 주장”이라고 비판했다.)

On the 23rd, on Facebook, Hong said, "An acquittal doesn't mean innocence; it just means that under criminal procedure, it doesn't constitute a crime. But modern society accepts that because of institutional inevitability. To argue that the ruling was wrong and that we should examine the recorded transcript, which has already been excluded as illegally obtained evidence, is an ignorant and uninformed claim that could only be made at a people's tribunal that fundamentally denies criminal procedure," targeting Han. (홍 전 시장은 23일 페이스북에서 “무죄는 결백하다는 게 아니고 형사절차상 죄가 안 된다는 뜻에 불과하지만 현대사회가 그걸 받아들이는 것은 제도상의 불가피성 때문이다. 그걸 두고 판결이 잘못됐으니 이미 위법수집증거로 배제된 증거인 녹취록을 까보자고 주장하는 건, 형사절차를 근본적으로 부정하는 인민재판에서나 할 수 있는 무식하고 무지한 주장”이라며 한 의원을 겨냥했다.)

The previous day, Hong also said on Facebook, "Han Dong-hoon argues that it wasn't an acquittal on the merits but because of the prosecution's illegally obtained evidence. If so, that's an admission of illegal investigation by the prosecution—so doesn't Han Dong-hoon, who directed and supervised the illegal investigation, bear responsibility? That's why I called him 'Korea's number one gum' instead of the 'Korea's number one sword' that the chaebol-friendly media praised him as." He then posted again, saying, "To say that a person who even served as minister of justice actually received money but was acquitted because of a formal principle of evidence exclusion is something you'd only say at a people's tribunal that denies the criminal justice system. With such a person having served as justice minister, how many people must have suffered unfairly?" (홍 전 시장은 전날에도 페이스북에서 “검찰의 위법수집증거 때문에 무죄가 된 것이지 무죄가 아니라(고) 한동훈은 반박한다. 그렇다면 검찰이 불법 수사를 자인한 것이 되는데 불법 수사를 지시·감독한 한동훈의 책임은 없는가”라며 “그래서 한동훈을 족벌 언론이 칭송한 ‘조선제일검’이 아니라 ‘조선제일껌’이라고 내가 한 것”이라고 말했다. 이어 재차 글을 올려 “법무장관까지 한 사람이 실제로 돈을 받았는데 형식적인 증거배제 원칙 때문에 무죄가 됐다는 말은, 형사사법체계를 부정하는 인민재판 할 때나 할 수 있는 말”이라며 “그런 사람이 법무장관을 했으니 얼마나 억울한 사람들이 많았겠나”라고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 21st, Han said on Facebook, "Former lawmaker Noh wasn't acquitted because it was revealed he didn't actually receive money, but because of the formal reason of excluding illegally obtained evidence (such as recording files). He shouldn't mislead the public into thinking he was unfairly investigated and tried." (앞서 한 의원은 지난 21일 페이스북에서 “노 전 의원은 실제로 돈을 받지 않은 것이 드러나 무죄 받은 것이 아니라 위법수집증거(녹음파일 등) 배제라는 형식적 이유로 무죄받은 것”이라며 “마치 억울하게 수사받고 재판받은 것처럼 국민들을 호도하면 안 된다”고 주장했다.)

On the 22nd, he also said, "Even if the court excluded the evidence as illegally obtained due to the prosecutor's failure to obtain an additional warrant—a formal reason for acquittal—the reality of the cash envelope doesn't disappear. If he's going to keep insisting he's innocent and blameless, let's all listen to the recording files (related to Noh's charges) together in the National Assembly." (22일에도 “수사검사가 추가로 영장 받지 않았다는 것을 문제 삼아 법원이 위법수집증거라고 증거에서 배제한 형식적 이유로 무죄가 나왔을지언정 돈봉투 받은 실체가 없어지지 않는다”며 “억울하고 잘못이 없는 것처럼 계속 우길 거면, 국회에서 (노 전 의원 혐의 관련) 녹음파일을 다 같이 한번 들어보자”라고 말했다.)

On the 21st, the Seoul Central District Court's Criminal Division 5-2 (Presiding Judge Kim Yong-jung) acquitted former lawmaker Noh, upholding the first-instance ruling. The court stated, "Examining the seizure and search of the mobile phone in this case, it constitutes an unlawful evidence collection procedure that violates the warrant requirement, and therefore the evidence is inadmissible." Noh was indicted in March 2023 on charges of receiving 60 million won from the wife of a businessman between February and December 2020 under the pretext of arranging logistics center permits and providing conveniences for solar power projects. (지난 21일 서울중앙지법 형사5-2부(재판장 김용중)는 노 전 의원에게 1심에 이어 무죄를 선고했다. 재판부는 “이 사건 휴대전화 압수수색과 탐색 선별 과정을 보면 영장주의에 반하는 위법한 증거 수집 절차에 해당해 증거능력이 없다고 판단된다”고 했다. 노 전 의원은 2020년 2월부터 12월까지 물류센터 인허가 알선, 태양광 발전 사업 편의 제공 등 명목으로 한 사업가의 부인에게 6000만원을 받은 혐의로 2023년 3월 기소돼 재판을 받아왔다.)

In relation to this, Han, during his tenure as minister of justice in December 2022, explained in the National Assembly the reason for requesting Noh's arrest consent, saying, "Even the sound of cash envelopes rustling was recorded," which drew criticism from the Democratic Party for "disclosing suspect information." (관련해 한 의원은 법무부 장관 시절인 2022년 12월 국회에서 노 전 의원 체포동의 요청 이유를 밝히며 “돈봉투 부스럭거리는 소리까지 녹음돼 있다”고 말해 민주당으로부터 ‘피의사실 공표’라는 비판을 받은 바 있다.)

In a statement released on the 21st, Noh said, "Han Dong-hoon, who manipulated evidence by calling simple noise the 'sound of cash envelopes rustling,' must now clearly take responsibility. I will take the lead in ensuring that no one becomes an innocent victim of fabricated indictments and fabricated investigations again." (노 전 의원은 21일 낸 입장문을 통해 “단순한 잡음을 ‘돈봉투 부스럭 소리’라고 증거 조작한 한동훈은 이제 확실히 책임져야 할 것”이라며 “다시는 조작 기소, 조작 수사로 억울한 피해자가 생기지 않도록 하는 데 앞장서겠다”고 했다.)

Jeon Kwang-jun reporter, light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party: "Extraordinary Chief Justice, Political Player Cho Hee-dae... Resign Immediately" (민주 “희대의 대법원장, 정치 플레이어 조희대…즉각 사퇴하라”)
item.description:
Park Sung-joon, the senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 23rd, "Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae has already become a political player," and "he must resign immediately from his post as Chief Justice." (박성준 더불어민주당 수석대변인이 23일 “조희대 대법원장은 이미 정치 플레이어가 됐다”며 “즉각 대법원장에서 사퇴해야 한다”고 말했다.)

At a briefing held at the National Assembly that day, Senior Spokesperson Park said, "As the head of the judiciary, Chief Justice Cho has thrown away the dignity he should uphold and has fallen to the level of an 'extraordinary Chief Justice.'" He added, "Resignation is the only way to atone before the collapsed judicial justice and the people." (박 수석대변인은 이날 국회에서 브리핑을 열어 “조 대법원장은 사법부의 수장으로서 마땅히 지켜야 할 품격을 스스로 내던진 채 ‘희대의 대법원장’으로 전락했다”며 “사퇴만이 무너진 사법 정의와 국민 앞에 속죄하는 유일한 길”이라고 말했다.)

Meeting with reporters after the briefing, Senior Spokesperson Park criticized, "Chief Justice Cho seems to be under the misapprehension that the power to recommend Supreme Court justices is the power to appoint them," adding, "He misunderstands the democratic system." He further stated, "The judiciary has the authority to recommend justices, the president elected by the people holds the final power of appointment, and the lawmakers chosen by the people hold the power of consent. This is done to stabilize the democratic system. Do you think past chief justices met with presidents face-to-face and exchanged views for no reason?" (박 수석대변인은 브리핑 뒤 취재진을 만나 “조 대법원장은 (대법관 후보) 제청권이 임명권이라고 착각하고 있다”며 민주주의 시스템을 잘못 이해하고 있는 것”이라고 비판했다. 그러면서 “사법부는 대법관 제청 권한이 있고, 거기에 대해 국민이 선출한 대통령에 최종 임명권을 주고, 국민의 선택을 받은 국회의원들에게 동의권을 주는 것”이라며 “이건 민주적 시스템 안정화를 위해 하는 것이다. (괜히) 역대 대법원장이 다 대통령과 대면으로 만나 의견을 나눴겠나”라고 했다.)

Chief Justice Cho had failed to recommend a successor for five months following the retirement of former Justice Noh Tae-ak in March, but suddenly broke with precedent on the 18th by submitting two candidates to President Lee Jae-myung in writing. (조 대법원장은 지난 3월 퇴임한 노태악 전 대법관의 후임을 5개월 동안 제청하지 않다가, 갑자기 지난 18일 관례를 깨고 후보자 2명을 이재명 대통령에게 ‘서면 제청’했다.)

Regarding the possibility of impeaching Chief Justice Cho, Senior Spokesperson Park answered, "He certainly has ample qualifications to be impeached," but only added, "Shouldn't the judiciary provide an answer on the issues related to Chief Justice Cho?" As for the abolition of the Court Administration Office, which has been mentioned as one of the judicial reforms publicly promised by Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok, he said, "This is not the time to discuss that." (박 수석대변인은 조 대법원장 탄핵 가능성에 대해서는 “탄핵 당할 충분한 자질이 있다”면서도 “사법부가 조 대법원장 관련 문제에 대해 답을 내놔야 하는 것 아니냐”고만 답했다. 김민석 민주당 대표가 공언한 사법 개혁의 하나로 거론되는 법원행정처 폐지에 대해선 “지금 단계에서 언급할 일은 아니”라고 했다.)

Kim Chae-woon, Reporter cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)
